name: Extreme Grain Carry Regime Persistence
description: Tests whether extreme backwardation (carry > 5%) or extreme contango (carry < -5%) in corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS) predicts the carry regime one quarter (63 trading days) ahead. Uses futures_continuation carry signal. Scatter shows current extreme carry vs 63-day forward carry to reveal persistence. Summary stats show hit rate (% of days where carry sign persists) and median forward carry by extreme regime.
source:
# Extreme Grain Carry Regime Persistence
# Does extreme backwardation (>5%) or contango (<-5%) predict next quarter carry?
# Carry > 0 = backwardation (front > back), Carry < 0 = contango
# Threshold: |carry| > 0.05 (5%) filters to strongest regimes only

# --- Data ---
ts = index()().value
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry

# --- Forward carry (63 trading days ≈ 1 quarter) ---
# Use << operator, NOT forward_returns (carry can cross zero → division by zero)
fwd_carry_63 = carry << 63

# --- Extreme regime classification (5% threshold) ---
is_extreme_bwd = is_valid(carry) and carry > 0.05
is_extreme_ctg = is_valid(carry) and carry < -0.05
is_extreme = is_extreme_bwd or is_extreme_ctg

# --- Forward carry filtered by current extreme regime ---
bwd_fwd = where(is_extreme_bwd, fwd_carry_63)
ctg_fwd = where(is_extreme_ctg, fwd_carry_63)

# --- Persistence: did carry keep the same sign after extreme reading? ---
# Hit = 1.0 if forward carry has same sign as current extreme carry
bwd_hit = 1.0 if (is_extreme_bwd and is_valid(fwd_carry_63) and fwd_carry_63 > 0) else 0.0
bwd_hit_filtered = where(is_extreme_bwd and is_valid(fwd_carry_63), bwd_hit)

ctg_hit = 1.0 if (is_extreme_ctg and is_valid(fwd_carry_63) and fwd_carry_63 < 0) else 0.0
ctg_hit_filtered = where(is_extreme_ctg and is_valid(fwd_carry_63), ctg_hit)

# --- Event markers: entries into extreme regimes ---
# Detect transition INTO extreme (yesterday was not extreme, today is)
prev_carry = carry >> 1
was_extreme_bwd = is_valid(prev_carry) and prev_carry > 0.05
was_extreme_ctg = is_valid(prev_carry) and prev_carry < -0.05

enter_extreme_bwd = is_extreme_bwd and not was_extreme_bwd
enter_extreme_ctg = is_extreme_ctg and not was_extreme_ctg
is_extreme_entry = enter_extreme_bwd or enter_extreme_ctg
regime_label = "Extreme Backwardation" if enter_extreme_bwd else "Extreme Contango"

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Carry Regime Entry',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry, regime_label, cont.c, is_extreme_entry)

# --- Chart 1: Scatter — extreme carry now vs carry in 63d ---
# Only plot days with extreme carry; trend line reveals persistence strength
# Filter carry and forward carry to extreme days only
extreme_carry = where(is_extreme, carry)
extreme_fwd = where(is_extreme, fwd_carry_63)

xy_scatter(
    title='Does Extreme Carry (>5%) Predict Next Quarter Carry?',
    x_axis_label='Current Carry (Extreme Only)',
    y_axis_label='Carry in 63 Trading Days',
    category='Extreme Carry Persistence',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=4,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=extreme_carry, y_values=extreme_fwd)

# --- Chart 2: Bars — median forward carry by extreme regime ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Where Does Carry Land After Extreme Readings?',
    y_axis_label='Median Carry in 63d',
    category='Extreme Carry Persistence',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='After Extreme Backwardation (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='After Extreme Contango (<-5%)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd))

# --- Chart 3: Summary table — extreme regime persistence stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Extreme Carry Persistence Stats (63d Forward)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['N (Extreme Days)', 'Hit Rate (Sign Persists)', 'Median Fwd Carry', 'Worst Fwd Carry'],
        col_headers=['Backwardation >5%', 'Contango <-5%'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='Extreme Carry Persistence',
    order=0
)(bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd, bwd_hit_filtered, ctg_hit_filtered, bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd, bwd_fwd, ctg_fwd)
